description: This file defines the interface class IGstGenericPlayerPrivate within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It declares a set of pure virtual methods related to GStreamer media pipeline control, such as scheduling data, updating caps, changing pipeline state, and handling underflow events. The class is intended for implementation by components managing GStreamer media playback, specifically for private or internal use within the Rialto media server.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerPrivate
classes.description: An interface class defining methods for managing GStreamer media pipeline operations, including scheduling media data, updating media caps, changing pipeline states, and handling underflow conditions.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData
methods.description: Schedules a task to request more media data for a given GstAppSrc.

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Schedules a task indicating enough media data is available.

methods.name: scheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Schedules a task indicating all media sources are attached.

methods.name: setWesterossinkRectangle
methods.description: Sets the sink rectangle for Westeros display; returns true on success.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies the system that media data is needed, specifying whether audio and video notifications are required.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Creates a GstBuffer from a media segment, without decryption.

methods.name: attachAudioData
methods.description: Attaches audio data to the pipeline.

methods.name: attachVideoData
methods.description: Attaches video data to the pipeline.

methods.name: updateAudioCaps
methods.description: Updates audio media caps based on new media segment metadata.

methods.name: updateVideoCaps
methods.description: Updates video media caps based on new media segment metadata.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the GStreamer pipeline state; returns true on success.

methods.name: startPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Starts position reporting and audio underflow checking.

methods.name: stopPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Stops position reporting and audio underflow checking.

methods.name: cancelUnderflow
methods.description: Restores playback after underflow, clearing the underflow flag.

methods.name: setPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the pending playback rate after reaching the PLAYING state.

methods.name: updatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Updates the playback group in the player context with the provided typefind element and caps.
